property_summary: For any address newOwner, when the current owner calls transferOwnership(newOwner) the contract's owner() becomes newOwner (the reference always updates the owner), whereas the mutant that removed the assignment leaves owner() unchanged for some newOwner values, so the post-call owner() must equal the provided newOwner.
change_summary: Replace the assignment 'owner = newOwner;' with a no-op (deleted) so transferOwnership no longer updates owner.
